parameters.name: SourceImageType
parameters.description:
Type of Image 1, with values:

- **FacePic**: User's face photo
- **IDPic**: Headshot from the user's second-generation ID card chip (typically obtained and decoded by a second-generation ID card reader)

parameters.name: SourceImageValue
parameters.description: Address of Image 1. Please refer to the instructions on uploading image addresses.

parameters.name: TargetImageType
parameters.description:
Type of Image 2, with values:

- **FacePic**: User's face photo
- **IDPic**: Headshot from the user's second-generation ID card chip (typically obtained and decoded by a second-generation ID card reader)

parameters.name: TargetImageValue
parameters.description: Address of Image 2. Please refer to the instructions on uploading image addresses.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth compare-faces --target-image-type FacePic --source-image-type FacePic --source-image-value http%3A%2F%2Fjiangsu.china.com.cn%2Fuploadfile%2F2015%2F0114%2F1421221304095989.jpg --target-image-value http%3A%2F%2Fjiangsu.china.com.cn%2Fuploadfile%2F2015%2F0114%2F1421221304095989.jpg --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth CompareFaces --region cn-hangzhou --TargetImageType FacePic --TargetImageValue 'http%3A%2F%2Fjiangsu.china.com.cn%2Fuploadfile%2F2015%2F0114%2F1421221304095989.jpg' --SourceImageType FacePic --SourceImageValue 'http%3A%2F%2Fjiangsu.china.com.cn%2Fuploadfile%2F2015%2F0114%2F1421221304095989.jpg'
